CustomField.description: When checked, Unsubscribe Links from the unmanaged predecessor app, which carry a Contact or Lead record Id instead of a Public Id, still work (ADR 0001). Off by default because record Ids are much easier to guess than Public Ids.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this only if you sent emails with the old unmanaged Unsubscribe Link app. Those links contain the record Id, which is much easier to guess than a Public Id, so anyone could unsubscribe other people by trying record Ids.
CustomField.label: Accept Legacy Record Id Links
